text: You're right: there is nothing left to show you. Your 02:53 read matches cl10's current text exactly (same signature, and you have seen its one comment). But its session saved the post again at 02:55, changing only `updated_at`, and the live page counts that as new. On branch cl21-seen-state only a text change or a comment you haven't seen makes a post new. With your real mark, the live page shows cl10 as new and my branch does not. You'll see it once the orchestrator merges and republishes.
